feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Questions remain after grand jury declines indictment in Nolan Wells' death
entry.summary: The Black Mississippi teen's family questions whether his race contributed to his July 4th death on an island off the Mississippi coast.

entry.title: 5 reasons why 'Choosin' Texas' is now the longest-running No. 1 hit of all time
entry.summary: Let's take a look at how and why "Choosin' Texas" has come to define and dominate the pop charts in 2026.

entry.title: Girl accuses Braden Peters, social media influencer known as 'Clavicular,' of rape
entry.summary: The allegations claim Braden Peters, also known as Clavicular, had non-consensual sex with the 17-year-old female victim after plying her with alcohol. Peters' representative denies the charges.

entry.title: White House launches 'Trump TV' after ban on major news outlets
entry.summary: Days after President Trump barred reporters from three major news outlets from the White House, the administration has launched a 24/7 YouTube channel promising to put its "biggest moments all in one place."

entry.title: Trump's D.C. arch is now a military complex. Here's how that complicates things
entry.summary: The future of Trump's D.C. arch was already fraught. Then he rebranded it as a military complex. Experts say that only raises more legal and logistical questions.

entry.title: The 2026 Booker Prize shortlist is 'writing at its best'
entry.summary: This year's shortlist is made up of former Booker winners and debut authors, with tales spanning a wide range of genres, from historical fiction to campus novel to dystopian fiction.

entry.title: This 'fire amoeba' pushes the limit of what's possible for complex life
entry.summary: Scientists have found a species they've named the fire amoeba, which is capable of reproducing at 145°F and continuing to move up to temperatures of 147°F — a record for complex eukaryotic life.

entry.title: Meet the future of the LA Philharmonic and San Francisco Symphony
entry.summary: As the classical concert season ramps up, two of America's finest orchestras will soon be led by new conductors when Daniel Harding takes over in Los Angeles and Elim Chan leads in San Francisco.

entry.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 over deadly 2019 Easter bombings
entry.summary: The Islamic State group-inspired attacks were among the deadliest in Sri Lanka's history, killing 42 foreigners.

entry.title: Houthis try to push deeper into western Yemen, upending life, witnesses tell NPR
entry.summary: As the U.S. conflict with Iran drags, the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen have opened a new front, taking new territory and displacing more than 100,000 people.
